mentions.name: s3fileviewer
mentions.description: A self-hosted, browser-based interface for previewing S3 files. It allows querying and viewing files beyond the size limits of the S3 console and provides information about column types in data files.
mentions.problem: The S3 console does not allow querying or viewing files beyond a certain size, and non-IT teams are often denied access out of concern for handling confidential data via the console.
mentions.audience: Non-IT teams in organizations who just want a preview of the data in files or want to do some simple explorations, and who are frequently denied S3 console access over concerns about confidential data.
mentions.source_excerpt: A self-hosted, better browser interface to preview s3 files. This overcomes the limitation of the s3 console not allowing querying or viewing files beyond a certain size. It also gives you information about the column types.
mentions.author: cgopalan
